title: DECSET 1016 — SGR-Pixels mouse mode
summary: CSI ? 1016 h enables SGR-Pixels mouse encoding: like 1006 (SGR) but reports pixel coordinates instead of cell coordinates. CSI ? 1016 l disables it.

frame.note: DEC private modes are CSI sequences with a leading '?' (0x3F) private-parameter prefix. Set = final byte 'h' (DECSET); reset = final byte 'l' (DECRST).

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: a DEC private mode is a CSI sequence ending at its final byte ('h' to set, 'l' to reset).

params.name: Enable (DECSET)
params.meaning: CSI ? 1016 h Mouse tracking; SGR pixel coordinates.

gotchas: Pixel mode reports X/Y in pixels, not cells.
Useful for graphical terminal applications that need sub-cell precision.
Requires 1006 (SGR) to be understood; 1016 is an extension.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: DECSET/DECRST 1016 render as byte-exact CSI ? 1016 h/l sequences.
